description: This file defines the MdmService class responsible for managing Mobile Device Management (MDM) configurations, including loading configs from system files, checking compliance, and handling platform-specific paths.

classes.name: MdmService
classes.description: A singleton class managing MDM configuration loading, compliance checks, and platform-specific config paths.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Loads MDM configuration asynchronously and logs the result.

methods.name: requiresCloudAuth
methods.description: Returns whether cloud authentication is required based on the loaded config.

methods.name: getRequiredOrganizationId
methods.description: Retrieves the required organization ID from the configuration.

methods.name: isCompliant
methods.description: Checks if the current environment complies with MDM policies.

methods.name: loadMdmConfig
methods.description: Reads and validates the MDM configuration file from the system.

methods.name: getMdmConfigPath
methods.description: Determines the platform-specific path to the MDM config file.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of MdmService.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates and initializes the singleton instance of MdmService.

methods.name: hasInstance
methods.description: Checks if the singleton instance exists.

methods.name: resetInstance
methods.description: Resets the singleton instance (for testing purposes).
